remarks: Start your summer at the picturesque and peaceful Winnipauk Village-offering more amenities than most communities! Residents enjoy two sparkling pools, Newer tennis and pickleball courts, beautifully landscaped grounds perfect for walking or jogging, a fitness center with a racquetball court, and a clubhouse ideal for gatherings and events. This freshly painted, two-bedroom townhouse-style condominium features brand-new high-performance Pergo flooring in the entryway, kitchen, half bath, and primary bedroom. The spacious living room includes a dedicated dining area and sliding doors that open to a large private deck with a scenic bird's-eye view overlooking one of the pools and the lush, manicured grounds. Additional highlights include central air, an in-unit laundry closet conveniently located on the upper level, a reserved parking space, and plenty of visitor parking nearby. Winnipauk Village is ideally situated in a prime Norwalk location-just a short drive to Calf Pasture Beach, Cranbury Park, historic SoNo, Public Golf Course, schools, shopping, Metro-North train stations, major highways and more. Approximately 51 miles to Midtown Manhattan. Don't miss this opportunity to enjoy resort-style living all summer long!
